name: Plan Subtitles
description: Plans caption timing and placement deterministically, and checks routed caption wording notes against timed speech before recording supported fixes.

inputs.name: audio_spine
inputs.description: State input: audio_spine. Reads structure and optional max_words, the request-stated caption word ceiling emitted by mesh_spine; the brand caption_words_per_card and declared default apply only when the request states no count.

inputs.name: project_fps
inputs.description: State input: project_fps from catalog. Used to round a planned card to at least the gate's required frame count; defaults to the reels timeline rate for direct callers.

inputs.name: brand_effect
inputs.description: Brand template effect slots (injected by pipeline runner). Reads caption_case for subtitle casing, caption_words_per_card for the grouping's word ceiling (rung 7, finding 31), and subtitle_style for the caption look.

inputs.name: brand_style
inputs.description: Brand template style slots (injected by pipeline runner). Reads typography and color_palette to resolve the caption style; see library/tools/subtitle_style.py.

inputs.name: timeline_notes
inputs.description: The captain's notes routed to subtitle planning. The bridge pairs each note with timed speech and the caption entries generated from that same spine; the feedback handoff checks only those words. See library/tools/caption_feedback.py.

inputs.name: project_folder
inputs.description: Project path used to record speech-grounded caption fixes in the project's edit ledger.

outputs.name: subtitle_plan
outputs.description: State output: subtitle_plan. max_words is the word ceiling every card was grouped at (rung 7, finding 31): the request's explicit number when present, otherwise the brand template's effect.caption_words_per_card, otherwise the grouping default. Cards below the 0.5 second readable floor are held through a safe gap, merged with a same-block neighbour, or planning refuses; readability_issues names any remaining card above 25 characters per second.

outputs.name: caption_feedback_context
outputs.description: Bridge output: each routed note with up to three matching timed speech blocks, exact word times and the current caption entries on those blocks. Projected to the feedback handoff instead of the full spine.

outputs.name: caption_feedback_report
outputs.description: State output: whether caption feedback was reviewed, skipped because no notes arrived, and the outcome for each note. Supported caption corrections are recorded in the project's edit ledger and applied to this plan.

llm_outputs.name: caption_feedback
llm_outputs.description: One result per note id shown in caption_feedback_context. Each result: note_id, action (caption_fix | already_correct | upstream_transcript_needed | outside_scope), reason. already_correct and upstream_transcript_needed require requested_phrase. caption_fix requires anchor_phrase and replacement, both quoted from the shown speech and current caption evidence. The post-bridge validates coverage and checks claims against timed speech before it records anything.
